summary.title: Welcome to the Neighborhood: Cookouts, Devils, and HOA Wars on the Strider
summary.synopsis: Settled into their new Fane aboard the colossal Strider, Iconoclasm spends a week building alliances with neighboring organizations before the pilgrimage departs. They host a cookout, meet key representatives from the Scale, Hildebrandt, Solari Sub-surface, and others, and discover the Master of Ceremonies is a devil — the Harlequin — who openly expects and will encourage deadly conflict between the 19 orgs aboard. The party scrambles to network, share intel via heart connections, and prepare for the violence to come.
key_beats: Argyle summons Chuck the Harlequin butler and dispatches invitations to neighboring orgs for a cookout; the twins are tasked with building a new car bonnet and inspecting the engine.
Benny visits the Strider's luxury gym and spars with Ralph Bishop, a gold-scaled lizardfolk Scale seer, and Paavo Karu, an elderly Hildebrandt aeronautics engineer, gauging their combat prowess.
Anzu meditates on void paper over the week and discovers the Strider's spinning gyroscopic rings momentarily redirect the Voidsong pull, and that the pull is noticeably stronger aboard the Strider.

Iconoclasm hosts a cookout with a Soothing Spring hot tub; Johnny befriends Salvado Targona, a clueless Solari Sub-surface spreadsheet worker who thinks this is a networking event, while Anzu bonds with Paavo over their shared resonance with the Voidsong.

The party visits the Scale's Fane (heart named Asteris Lux) — a camouflaged forward operating base — and meets Bishop's team: the sickly Lance Vesper and rifleman Cassian. They agree to mutual intel-sharing and warn each other about Amber Call.

Meeting with the Master of Ceremonies at a private restaurant: he removes his mask to reveal a purposefully scarred burned face. Argyle's religion check identifies a fiendish sulfur scent linked to the Harlequin, one of four recently organized devils (Shackle/Sigzilheit, Harlequin, Hooded, Loam). The MC confirms he expects and will encourage violence between orgs, hints Illmari is alive, and warns the party 'you don't want to be my favorite.'
Argyle casts Consult the Spirits and confirms their heart Eerie is NOT subservient to the Harlequin devil.

The party goes door-to-door meeting orgs: Protectorate (Tamara and Yao — friendly, connect hearts to network), Iridescent Church (Reverend Walter Stoke — a blind, politically savvy priest not seeking allies), Necrolog (Gaspar Caetano — a dhampir who brushes them off), and Prime Meridian (Tas Millet — a hobgoblin bureaucrat who agrees to a two-way heart info-sharing arrangement but stops short of alliance).

The full roster of 19 orgs and their birth positions is revealed; the party strategizes about protecting weak orgs like Garrick Textiles and Solari Sub-surface from Amber Call, debates naming their alliance 'Chronicle,' and sets up defensive preparations. Johnny commissions blast boots from the twins.
summary.cliffhanger: The party has learned the Master of Ceremonies is a devil expecting — and encouraging — violence between the 19 orgs on the pilgrimage. They scramble to build alliances and fortify their position, with Amber Call dangerously positioned next to vulnerable orgs like Garrick Textiles and Solari Sub-surface.
